featured_reviews.name: Humaira Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother frequently order food form here and I recently tasted and I must say  it truly exceeded my expectations. My mother absolutely loves their food, and honestly, that says a lot in our house! Every single dish we’ve tried so far has been consistently amazing  full of flavor, perfectly cooked, and served fresh.
I recently tried their seekh kebab, and I was genuinely impressed. The texture was just right  juicy, well-seasoned, and grilled to perfection with that smoky flavor that makes all the difference.
And trust me, I have very precise taste buds and rarely like food instantly. But this? It won me over in the first bite.
The quality, taste, and consistency really stand out. If you’re someone who values authentic flavors and well-balanced spices, this place is definitely worth trying.The Seekh was so good that I had to give the review for this place.Highly recommended  especially if you’re as picky with food as I am! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Mustafa Dhukka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mezban Restaurant is one of the best places in Nalasopara for delicious and freshly prepared food. The ambiance is simple yet comfortable, making it a great spot for both family dinners and casual hangouts with friends. The seating arrangement is spacious, and the cleanliness is always maintained well.

The menu offers a wide variety of dishes — from North Indian curries to Chinese and Tandoori specials. Each dish is cooked to perfection, with rich flavors and fresh ingredients that truly stand out. The chicken and mutton dishes here are a must-try for non-veg lovers, while vegetarians will find plenty of tasty options too.

The service is prompt, and the staff is friendly, attentive, and always ready to customize dishes as per your preference. Portion sizes are generous, making the food worth every penny you spend.

Their biryani is especially popular — aromatic, flavorful, and loaded with perfectly cooked meat and rice. Along with the main course, starters like kebabs, spring rolls, and crispy chicken are also crowd favorites.

The prices are reasonable, and considering the quality, it offers excellent value for money. They also provide takeaway and home delivery, which is quick and neatly packed.

Whether you are planning a family dinner, a celebration, or just craving some good food, Mezban Restaurant never disappoints. It’s a place you will want to visit again and again for its taste, hospitality, and overall dining experience.

I have visited this place many times and it has become one of my favorites! I’ve tried Chicken Manchow Soup, Chicken Triple Rice, Chicken Chopper Rice, Apple Chicken Gravy, Chicken Crispy, Chicken Fried Rice, Chicken Lollipop, and Chicken Burnt Garlic Rice and the taste has always been absolutely amazing. The best part is they don’t use excess food coloring, and the flavors of all their Chinese dishes are just perfect.

The portions are generous (enough for 2 people) and prices are very reasonable. They offer both AC and non-AC seating with ample tables, and the place is neat, clean, and spacious. Along with Chinese, they also have a quick-bite menu including pizza, pasta, fries, burgers, frankies, etc. The restaurant is open 24/7, making it the perfect late-night spot. Their Chinese menu is my absolute favorite. A must-visit for Chinese cuisine lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Asian Treat near St Anne's school in Vasai West today for lunch. Becautiful location, ample parking place, very well planned menu ranging from kebabs to parathas and roti to lassi. Very well trained staff and well decorated seating area. We were greeted with a lot of warmth and the waiter took extra carento suggest suitable options. In veg we tried paneer cheese kebab and paneer paratha. In non-veg the lasuni chicken tikka, seekh kebab, roti with paneed kadhai were fantabulous. I wish they keep diet coke in the options. The place is not air conditioned but its airy and open-fresh so you dont need an air conditioned area here at least. Good experience.

featured_reviews.name: wilfred pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Asian Treat and had a delightful dining experience. Here are some highlights:

Food Quality:
The dishes were exceptional. I tried the Chinese, indian and Mutton raan with yakhni rice , and each one was flavorful and well-prepared. The mutton ran  was particularly outstanding, with its flavours.

Service:
The staff at Asian Treat were friendly and attentive. Our server, Mr. Guru & Mr. Sopan, was knowledgeable about the menu and provided excellent recommendations. The service was prompt, and our orders arrived quickly.

Ambiance:
The restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere. The decor is cozy & elegant. and the seating is comfortable. It’s a great place for both casual dining and special occasions.

Cleanliness:
The restaurant was clean and well-maintained. The tables were spotless, and the overall hygiene standards were high.

Overall Experience:
Asian Treat offers a fantastic dining experience with delicious food, great service, and a welcoming ambiance. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality Asian cuisine.

featured_reviews.name: alka gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a child’s birthday celebration at this venue. The décor was elegant and created a warm, festive atmosphere appropriate for the occasion. The food was generally delicious and well-presented, earning compliments from many of our guests.

Nevertheless, a few aspects require attention. Some of the starters were served cold, diminishing their overall appeal. Service between courses was considerably delayed, resulting in extended waiting periods that interrupted the flow of the event. Furthermore, the vegetarian selection was limited. Expanding the menu with additional innovative vegetarian dishes would cater to a broader clientele.

In conclusion, while the venue demonstrates strong potential through its ambiance and culinary quality, improvements in service efficiency, food temperature, and menu diversity are necessary to deliver a seamless dining experience. We would gladly consider returning if these concerns be addressed.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi alka,
Thank you for sharing your experience with us. It’s wonderful to hear that the décor and the food presentation were highlights for your child's birthday celebration. However, it’s disheartening to learn about the service delays and the issue with the temperature of the starters. Improving our service speed is a priority, and we are actively working on enhancing the training of our staff to ensure a more seamless experience. Your suggestion for an expanded vegetarian menu is also valuable, and we will definitely take that into consideration as we plan our future offerings.

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing family dinner at Farmhouse Funfiesta and the experience was truly memorable! Located opposite Miraj Cinemas in Nalasopara, this fine-dine restaurant is perfect for both family outings and party nights.

The place has huge parking space, a beautiful aesthetic ambiance, and even a separate area for private family gatherings (15–20 people comfortably). There’s also a well-stocked bar with crazy offers on alcohol and mocktails – Buy 2 Get 1 Free on cocktails/mocktails and draft beers, plus special birthday and anniversary deals.

We tried Cocktail King Prawns, Bombil Rawa Fry, Steamed Chicken Momos, and Naram Dil Kebabs in starters – all were fresh and super tasty. For mains, the Kolhapuri Tambda Pandhra Rassa, Chicken Sagoti, Paneer Khurchan, and especially the Burmese Khow Suey Chicken were outstanding – definitely a must-try!

Ended the meal with their chef’s special baked cheesecake – absolutely delicious.

Great food, great offers, beautiful vibe – 100% recommended for family dinners or celebrations!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Ashish,
Celebrating moments with family is what we aim for, and it's wonderful to hear that your dinner at Farmhouse Funfiesta was so meaningful. The variety you experienced with our starters and mains truly reflects our commitment to quality. Thank you for highlighting our ambiance and special offers—it’s great to know they contributed to your memorable evening!

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse

It was decent, but didn’t really stand out to me.
The solkadi was above average (3/5), while the bombil fry, kolambi fry, surmai thali, and modak were average overall (2.5/5).
The taste was simple, which some people may enjoy, but I personally felt the place is slightly overhyped for the price point.

If you're looking for a beautiful and peaceful spot by the beach, especially at night, this restaurant is a must-visit!"😊😊😊😊😊😊
